parameters.query: best practices for file upload and download security in web applications
parameters.snippet:
print("Testing filename validation...")
test_filenames = [
    "valid_song.mp3",
    "../invalid_song.mp3",
    "invalid|song.mp3",
    "another_invalid:song.mp3"
]

for filename in test_filenames:
    assert isinstance(filename, str) and not any(char in filename for char in ['..', '<', '>', ':', '"', '/', '\\', '|', '?', '*']), f"Invalid filename: {filename}"
print("Filename validation test completed.")
